newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Dublin Airport June passenger traffic tops one mln.
newsitem.headline: Dublin Airport June passenger traffic tops one mln.

text.p: Irish airports authority Aer Rianta said on Monday that passenger traffic through Dublin airport exceeded one million in June, a 15 percent increase on last year.
The busiest day ever in the airport was recorded in June when more than 44,000 passengers passed through the terminal on June 29, Aer Rianta said in a statement.

Traffic to and from UK destinations showed the highest level of growth at 24 percent and accounted for 55 percent of total throughput in June while transatlantic traffic grew by 14 percent and European passenger numbers by four percent.

Aer Rianta said over 135,000 passengers passed through Cork Airport in June, a four percent increase on June 1996, while Shannon Airport saw a one percent rise in passenger traffic numbers last month.
